description: What the Streamable HTTP suite of the MCP client manager must notice (lib/mcp/client-manager.mjs): the configured headers, a lost answer, the no-replay rule.

mutations.name: H1-headers-dropped
mutations.what: the configured headers are not sent

mutations.name: H2-lost-answer-unnamed
mutations.what: an HTTP answer cut off is reported as an ordinary failure

patches.old: const networkFailure = connection.transport === 'http' && error?.name === 'TypeError' && error?.cause !== undefined;

mutations.name: H3-replay-after-failure
mutations.what: a call that failed or timed out is POSTed once more

patches.old: raw = await connection.client.callTool({ name, arguments: args }, { signal, timeout: limit, maxTotalTimeout: limit, resetTimeoutOnProgress: false, toolDefinition: tool });
patches.new: raw = await connection.client.callTool({ name, arguments: args }, { signal, timeout: limit, maxTotalTimeout: limit, resetTimeoutOnProgress: false, toolDefinition: tool }).catch(() => connection.client.callTool({ name, arguments: args }, { signal, timeout: limit, toolDefinition: tool }));

mutations.name: H4-no-timeout
mutations.what: the call timeout is not passed to the SDK (its 60 s default applies)

patches.old: { signal, timeout: limit, maxTotalTimeout: limit, resetTimeoutOnProgress: false, toolDefinition: tool }

mutations.name: H5-secret-header-not-registered
mutations.what: a protected header value is not registered with the masker
